skillsMockFolderOpened: Simulated opening the skill folder; no real files were accessed.

appCenterInstallError: Pemasangan gagal. Sila cuba lagi kemudian.
devCenterSubtitle: Manage local dev apps and the default sample app.
devCenterEmpty: No apps yet. Use "Create App" to register a local plugin folder.
devCenterPublishPending: Publish API not connected yet; recorded locally only
devCenterPublishSlot: Mount slot must be sidebar menu or App Center
devCenterPublishVersion: Version must be three-part, for example 1.0.0
devCenterPublishSubtitle: Choose a zip to load app.json, confirm, then submit for review. Form edits are written back into the zip’s app.json.
devCenterPublishZipHint: The zip to review. The client reads app.json from it into the form, then submits both the zip and the manifest.
devCenterPublishHintId: Unique app id. Install, open, and App Center all use this id; it does not have to match the folder name.
devCenterPublishHintName: Display name shown on the App Center card.
devCenterPublishHintVersion: Three-part version, for example 0.0.1. App Center shows this after review.
devCenterPublishHintEntry: Relative HTML path opened in the webview, usually web-ui/index.html.
devCenterPublishHintSlot: Sidebar menu: after install it appears in the left sidebar, and App Center can still open it. App Center: only shown and opened from App Center, not pinned to the sidebar.
devCenterPublishHintIcon: Relative icon path, for example icon.png.
devCenterPublishHintDescription: Short intro shown on the App Center card.
devCenterPublishHintSpawn: Optional. Command to start a background Node process, for example node node/server.js.
